fields.headline: Shelters open for the Cinder Creek Fire

shelters.name: Calloway High School gym
shelters.services: Cots, meals, medical screening; bring medications and ID.

shelters.name: Mill Valley Community Center
shelters.services: Opens at 7:00 PM; quiet room for people with medical needs.

shelters.name: County Fairgrounds, Gate B
shelters.services: Stalls, hay and water; bring halters and papers.

shelters.name: Fairgrounds pet area
shelters.services: Overflow at the Calloway Animal Shelter.

fields.pets: Service animals stay with their owners. Pets go to the fairgrounds pet area; bring a carrier.
